prompt:
Create the canonical anchor image for an engineering explainer video.

Primary subject:
Matte white freestanding two-door top-freezer refrigerator in an ordinary home kitchen, viewed initially from a rear three-quarter angle.

Identity features that must be visible and preserved in all later scenes:
- matte white body
- same top-freezer/two-door geometry
- same door proportions
- same handle/recess geometry
- same overall width-height proportions
- same kitchen environment when the physical object is visible

Visual direction:
Realism target: technical_realistic
Lighting: Soft natural indoor daylight with believable room shadows; no studio glow.
Camera style: Grounded real-camera perspective, mostly rear three-quarter and controlled cutaway views.
Environment: Ordinary compact home kitchen; realistic wall clearance and everyday surfaces.
Color notes: Neutral household colors; refrigerator remains matte white.

Use natural, believable photography cues. Keep proportions physically plausible.
Do not invent technical components that are not visible or specified.
Avoid artificial showroom perfection, excessive cinematic glow, or stylized CGI unless explicitly requested.
This image will be the master continuity reference for all later derived scenes.
negative_constraints: change to French-door or side-by-side layout
replace with a different refrigerator model
move to an unrelated kitchen without a context switch
alter component locations merely for visual convenience
continuity_constraints: Preserve: same kitchen environment when the physical object is visible
All physical refrigerator scenes must derive from A1 or an approved derivative.
Technical abstractions should preserve the recognizable fridge_01 silhouette when shown together with the appliance.
Scene 5 may compare heat-rejection layouts but must keep fridge_01 as the primary example.
technical_constraints: Do not expose invented internal components in the anchor image.
Keep the rear three-quarter view suitable for later cutaway overlays.
user_instructions: Use this prompt package in ChatGPT Image, then import the approved result into the project.
